operatorChecks: 確認先複製 reviewed-local-agent-health.template.json 成本地 reviewed-local-agent-health.json。
確認 reviewed-local-agent-health.json 只在本機使用，不 commit。
確認檔案已去敏，不含 API key、token、cookie、secret、Authorization、endpoint。
乾跑 validator 後才產生 local health report。
如 readiness 不是 ready-for-local-use，只可 fallback 到 local-file-only sample。
safeNextSteps: If validation passes, run local health report generators.
If validation fails, follow the report findings without printing raw values.
notAllowed: Do not include token, cookie, password, secret, apiKey, Authorization, endpoint, webhook, email, phone, privateKey, credentials, or session fields.
Do not restart, stop, or start agents from Dashboard.
